svg.aria-label: One attention layer with six independent knobs that compose. Which pairs attend: full, causal, sliding window or sparse. Where Q and K/V come from: self or cross attention. How K/V are stored: MHA, GQA, MQA or MLA. The score: softmax, a linear kernel, a decay or delta rule, or a state space. How it runs: naive, FlashAttention, PagedAttention or Ring Attention. Position: RoPE, ALiBi or none. A typical decoder LLM today picks causal, self, GQA, softmax, Flash and RoPE. Pick one on each knob, they mix freely, and a local sliding window layer can still be causal or bidirectional.
